div.div: مُجْرِعٌ A she-camel in which is not as much [milk] as will satisfy thirst, but only some sups: (K:) pl. مَجَارِيعُ (L, K) and مَجَارِعُ: (L:) J explains the former pl. as signifying she-camels having little milk; as though there were not in their udders more than some sups; and the sing. he does not mention. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
